units.source_text: 匯款依然是在兩三天揮霍殆盡，我驚慌失措，因心中沒底而變得近乎發瘋，

en.t: The money I received still vanished within two or three days, and I panicked, nearly going mad from anxiety and uncertainty,

units.source_text: 輪流給父親、哥哥、姐姐等發電報，或寫長信

en.t: I took turns sending telegrams to my father, my elder brother, my elder sister, and others, or writing them long letters

units.source_text: （信中所寫的，全是虛構的搞笑內容。

en.t: The things I wrote in those letters were all made-up comic stories.

units.source_text: 總覺得，求助於他人，先逗對方開心方是上策），催他們快點寄錢給我。

en.t: I always felt that when asking someone for help, the best tactic was to make them laugh first, and then I urged them to send me money quickly.

units.source_text: 而且，在堀木的教唆下，我開始頻繁地出入當鋪，

en.t: On top of that, egged on by Horiki, I began going in and out of pawnshops all the time,

units.source_text: 可即便這樣，還是入不敷出。

en.t: but even so, my expenses still exceeded my income.

units.source_text: 歸根結底，我還是缺乏在無親無故的租屋內獨自生活的能力。

en.t: In the end, I simply lacked the ability to live on my own in a boarding house where I had no relatives or connections.
